title: One MCP, All 50 States, Any AI Tool: Form and Run Your Company with doola
summary: Start an LLC or C Corp in any US state from ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP-compatible AI tools. doola customers can also check deadlines, documents and financials in chat.
body_markdown:
Founders open an AI assistant first thing every day. Now they can start and run their US company there too.


The doola MCP now offers LLC and C Corp formation in all 50 states, guided step by step in chat. And existing doola customers can connect their account and ask their AI Co-Founder about documents, deadlines, financials, sales and ad spend, right from ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP-compatible AI tools.


Two sentences show the difference:


- “Using doola, start my C Corp in Texas.”
- “Using doola, what’s due for my company this month?”


The first one forms your company. The second one helps you run it.


## From Wyoming to All 50 States


When the doola MCP launched in May 2026, it formed Wyoming LLCs. Today, it forms LLCs and C Corps in every US state.


That means you pick the state that fits your business, not the one your tool supports.


Forming a Delaware C Corp to raise from investors? Setting up an LLC in the state where you do business? You can start either one in the same chat.


Here’s how it works:


1. **Connect doola.** Add the doola connector in your AI assistant.
2. **Ask.** Type something like “Using doola, help me start an LLC” or “Using doola, start my C Corp in Delaware.”
3. **Follow the flow.** The doola MCP guides you through formation step by step, right in the chat.


No forms to hunt down. No tabs to juggle. Just a conversation with the assistant you already have open.


## Your AI Co-Founder, Now in Your AI Assistant


You form your company once. You run it every day.


Founders already live in Claude, ChatGPT and whichever AI tool they love. Now they can start a company in any of the 50 states and run it from that same chat, without logging in to one more dashboard. Their AI Co-Founder goes wherever they work. This is the next step in meeting founders where they are.


**Arjun Mahadevan** , Founder and CEO, doola


AI Co-Founder already answers founders’ questions inside the doola dashboard. Now existing doola customers can bring it to ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP-compatible AI tools. Sign in once with your doola account, and your assistant answers from your own company’s data. Only you see your data.


Here’s what your AI Co-Founder can pull up:


- **Company details:** Formation details, members, addresses, and EIN and ITIN application status
- **Documents:** Your Articles of Organization, EIN letter and other formation documents on file
- **Compliance:** Your compliance calendar, annual filing due date and tax filing status
- **Bookkeeping (for doola Bookkeeping customers):** P&L, balance sheet, cash flow statement and expense reports as a PDF or XLSX, plus invoices, transactions and uncategorized items
- **Sales and ads:** Orders, top products, sales by platform, ad campaigns and ad spend trends once you’ve connected Shopify, Amazon or your ad accounts in doola


What you see depends on the doola services on your account. For example, bookkeeping reports and transaction data are only available if you’re a doola Bookkeeping customer.


When something needs action, like filing your annual report or getting an ITIN, your AI Co-Founder points you to the right doola service so you can get it done.


## What You Can Ask


Type in plain language. Here are a few prompts to try:


What you want to do Try asking


Start an LLC “Using doola, help me start an LLC in California.”


Start a C Corp “Using doola, start my C Corp in Delaware.”


Find a document “Where’s my EIN letter?”


Check deadlines “When is my annual report due?”


See what’s coming up “What’s due for my company this month?”


Get your financials “Download my P&L as a PDF.”


Track ad spend “Show my total ad spend.”


Track sales “Show my Shopify sales trend.”


## Get Started Today


The doola MCP works in ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP-compatible AI tools.


1. **Connect doola.** Follow the[setup steps for your AI assistant](https://docs.doola.com/mcp/connect) .
2. **Starting a company?** Ask “Using doola, help me start my company” and pick your state and entity type.
3. **Already with doola?** Sign in once with your doola account, then ask your first question.


Start it and run it, all in one chat.


[Connect the doola MCP →](https://docs.doola.com/mcp/connect)
